entities.summary: Barbados is a sovereign nation in Caribbean, Americas. Its capital is Bridgetown. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic (republic since 2021, formerly Commonwealth realm). Population: approximately 0.3 million. Area: 430 km². Comprehensive index for Barbados covering Arawak/Carib indigenous peoples, Portuguese/Spanish contact, English colonization 1627, sugar revolution (first Caribbean sugar powerhouse), Bussa's Rebellion 1816, emancipation 1834, plantocracy dominance, Errol Barrow and Democratic Labour Party, independence 1966, cricket culture, becoming a republic 2021 (removed Queen as head of state), and Rihanna.
